description: Use this when the person asks how their week went or what changes next week. Reads the Sunday review of a program week (null is the latest): sessions, volume, new bests, the pace, each change Stoke made to next week with its reason, and what was kept and why. Those changes follow fixed rules: explain each from its reason, never invent another. Do not use for today's session; use get_today.
name: get_weekly_review
title: The Sunday review
